services.name: postgres
services.notes: Postgres for manual checks of the sql extra (dev/compose.worktree.yml): start it with compose_up from ports.txt, stop it with compose_down. A running stack is a heavy workload.

services.name: postgres_test
services.notes: The host port for the testcontainers Postgres the sql tests start: set CONDUIT_POSTGRES_TEST_PORT to it (and TESTCONTAINERS_RYUK_DISABLED=true) so the container binds 127.0.0.1 inside the slot. A test run is a heavy workload.

notes: The sql extra's tests start a throwaway Postgres through testcontainers when Docker is available (CONDUIT_POSTGRES_TESTS=auto, skip or require); every other test needs no service. The default test run never calls a live model or the network; live provider checks are marked integration and run only on the maintainer's word.
